data.desc: FreeCast, Inc. (Nasdaq: CAST) is a technology company providing a white-label Platform-as-a-Service for streaming television, entertainment, media discovery and monetization. FreeCast enables telecommunications companies, wireless operators, internet service providers, property operators and other organizations to offer branded entertainment and media experiences to their customers without having to build and maintain a complete streaming ecosystem. FreeCast's platform brings together free and paid streaming content, subscription services, live television and transactional entertainment within a unified discovery and monetization environment across connected devices.
